policy: Candidates are proposals only. No Core source may change until the user decides each item and P0 assigns an exact contract/write set.

items.title: Publish public Workspace/Document/Node/Revision/Relation/Asset/Candidate/Publication v1 contracts
items.need: Novel-Agent plugins cannot safely read or propose mutations against Core authority without public command/query/DTO/SDK contracts.
items.minimum_solution: Complete the already accepted scoped public-contract publication in P0, freeze JSON Schema plus Python/TypeScript SDK and pass Sol review.
items.fallback: No plugin construction; design remains gated.
acceptance: public contract methods callable by plugin host

items.title: Materialize SourceWorkspace and stable source document identity
items.need: The v1.2 design mentions future SourceWorkspace but the donor workflow needs a stable original-work research authority.
items.minimum_solution: Allow Core-created workspace_kind=source and stable Document/Node/Revision identities using the same generic authority and backup rules.
items.fallback: Use an ordinary workspace tagged by Core configuration only if the public contract already supports it without semantic ambiguity.

items.title: Browser-native file and paste Intake Broker
items.need: Plugin UI Workers have no DOM, file picker, clipboard or arbitrary filesystem access.
items.minimum_solution: Core renders TXT/EPUB chooser and paste control, enforces size/type limits, materializes an immutable raw Asset, then starts the selected import capability with that Asset.
items.fallback: User manually creates/imports an Asset through an existing Core asset screen if one can preserve the exact MIME/source kind contract.

items.title: Fixed /donors page and bounded Donor UI slots
items.need: Import cleaning, structure revision, evidence review and multi-stage donor analysis cannot fit safely into the existing workbench side panel.
items.minimum_solution: Core owns /donors and exactly seven bounded slots; plugins contribute worker-ui trees but cannot add routes.
items.fallback: Temporary use of workbench.reference.panel is allowed only for a minimal proof, not full delivery.

items.title: Exact Revision source search and EvidenceSpan query contract
items.need: Plugins require safe, bounded access to canonical source text, node ranges and exact Unicode coordinates without Core DB access.
items.minimum_solution: Publish read-only query commands for revision metadata, node tree, paged search and code-point span; return content hashes and immutable Asset references.
items.fallback: Pass the full canonical text as a RunSnapshot Asset for small books; this is not acceptable for large-book final delivery.

items.title: Register donor and derived mutation payload schemas
items.need: candidate-item/v1 permits only Core-registered mutation schemas; Atom, Claim, narrative, character, style and repair payloads need explicit identities.
items.minimum_solution: Add a bounded registry of closed payload schemas and target/entity compatibility without teaching Core literary algorithms.
items.fallback: Store a generic opaque JSON document only if its schema identity, hash, target and validator are still fixed and independently verifiable.

items.title: Cross-Workspace exact source reference picker
items.need: A-book plot, B-book character and C-book style composition requires user selection of exact published source revisions and assets.
items.minimum_solution: Core-native picker queries permitted SourceWorkspaces and creates a canonical immutable source-reference Asset for the RunSnapshot.
items.fallback: User supplies IDs through advanced settings; unsuitable for normal final UX.

items.title: Workspace fork command
items.need: Novel-Agent has a tested branch fork and branch Canon workflow, but plugins cannot authoritatively mint a workspace or branch identity.
items.minimum_solution: Publish idempotent workspace.fork/v1 that copies Core authority by reference/revision rules and returns a new workspace identity; no merge.
items.fallback: Defer branch fork and run Canon checks only inside one workspace.

items.title: Root-bound external knowledge projection Broker
items.need: Direct Obsidian/Vault projection requires a user-selected external directory that a plugin must not access arbitrarily.
items.minimum_solution: Core owns the root handle and accepts only generated Markdown Assets plus relative normalized paths; it enforces root binding and returns a receipt.
items.fallback: knowledge-projection emits a ZIP/Markdown Asset for user download.

items.title: Install Data Plugin package directly from immutable Core Asset
items.need: Cleaning-rule merge and style/template derivation can generate a .ppplugin package Asset; a convenient install path avoids export and reselect.
items.minimum_solution: Core plugin manager accepts an existing immutable Asset ID and runs the same package verification/install transaction as folder/ZIP selection.
items.fallback: Export package then user chooses it in Settings -> Plugins.
